description: ID5 CTV server-to-server fetch on api.id5-sync.com/gc/v1. ID5 documents partner, ts, appid, ver, ip, and ua as required. Mobile in-app /ga/v1 is vendor/id5. Cookie sync on /i/ and /s/ is not contracted.

params.description: ID5 accepts a JSON object as its request body.

params.name: partner
params.description: It is the ID5 Partner Number. ID5 documents partner as required on /gc/v1.
params.fix_hint: Set partner to the Partner Number ID5 issued. Use 173 only while testing.

params.name: ts
params.description: It is the request timestamp. ID5 documents ts as required, as an ISO-8601 string with a time zone offset.
params.fix_hint: Set ts to an ISO-8601 timestamp with offset, such as 2013-02-01T12:52:34+09:00.

params.name: appid
params.description: It is the store ID of the app. ID5 documents appid as required on /gc/v1.
params.fix_hint: Set appid to the Apple App Store, Google Play, or equivalent store ID.

params.name: ver
params.description: It is the application version. ID5 documents ver as required.
params.fix_hint: Set ver to the app version string.

params.name: ip
params.description: It is the IPv4 address closest to the device. ID5 documents ip as required.
params.fix_hint: Send the device-facing IPv4 address, unhashed.

params.name: ua
params.description: It is the device default-browser user agent. ID5 documents ua as required.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw user agent string, unhashed.

params.name: hem
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hash of the cleansed email. ID5 documents hem as sha256 when present.
params.fix_hint: Normalize and SHA-256 hash the identifier, then send its 64-character hexadecimal digest.

params.name: phone
params.description: It is a SHA-256 hash of the cleansed phone number.
params.fix_hint: Normalize and SHA-256 hash the identifier, then send its 64-character hexadecimal digest.

params.name: provider
params.description: ID5 documents provider as an optional string request field.

params.name: signature
params.description: ID5 documents signature as an optional string request field.

params.name: gdpr_consent
params.description: ID5 documents gdpr_consent as an optional string request field.

params.name: gpp_string
params.description: ID5 documents gpp_string as an optional string request field.

params.name: region
params.description: ID5 accepts ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, or a two-letter state code for the USA.

params.name: city
params.description: ID5 names the UN/LOCODE format, two country letters followed by three letters or digits 2 through 9.

params.name: accept_language
params.description: ID5 requires compatibility with the browser Accept-Language header. RFC 9110 and RFC 4647 define basic language ranges and optional quality weights from 0 to 1 with at most three fractional digits.

params.name: gdpr
params.description: ID5 documents 1 when GDPR applies and 0 otherwise.

params.name: allowed_vendors
params.description: ID5 documents allowed_vendors as an array of vendor identifier strings.

params.name: allowed_vendors[]
params.description: ID5 accepts ID5-prefixed partner identifiers or numeric IAB vendor IDs.

params.name: us_privacy
params.description: ID5 accepts the IAB US Privacy String.

params.name: gpp_sid
params.description: ID5 allows one GPP section ID or at most two comma-separated section IDs.

params.name: idfv
params.description: ID5 documents the Apple vendor identifier in UUID format.

params.name: ipv6
params.description: ID5 documents ipv6 as the device IPv6 address.

params.name: country
params.description: ID5 documents country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

params.name: segments
params.description: ID5 documents segments as an array of objects.

params.name: segments[]
params.description: Every ID5 segment entry is an object.

params.name: hardware_code
params.description: ID5 documents hardware_code as an optional string request field.

params.name: ottid
params.description: ID5 marks ottid deprecated in favor of the identifiers array.

params.name: ctvid
params.description: ID5 marks ctvid deprecated in favor of the identifiers array.

params.name: ctvid_type
params.description: ID5 marks ctvid_type deprecated in favor of the identifiers array.

params.name: puid
params.description: ID5 marks puid deprecated in favor of the identifiers array.

params.name: identifiers
params.description: ID5 documents CTV advertising identifiers as an array.

params.name: identifiers[]
params.description: Each CTV identifier is an object containing id and type.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. ID5 documents hem as a SHA-256 digest of a cleansed email.
rules.fix_hint: Cleanse the email, hash it with SHA-256, and send it as hem.

rules.message: ID5 specifies a two-letter state code for USA regions.
ID5 permits the two-letter state abbreviation only for the United States. Other supplied countries require an ISO 3166-2 region code.

params.name: destination
params.description: Every segment needs its destination IAB vendor identifier.

params.name: ids
params.description: Every segment needs an array of string segment identifiers.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Segment identifiers are strings.

params.name: id
params.description: ID5 requires the identifier value. UUID is usual, but other identifier formats are supported.

params.name: type
params.description: ID5 requires the identifier type. Values outside its named types are accepted as UNKNOWN.

rules.message: ID5 recommends lowercasing the CTV identifier value.

params.name: method
params.description: The published endpoint accepts an HTTP POST request.

params.name: content_type
params.description: The request Content-Type is application/json; MIME parameters do not change its media type.

params.name: body_encoding
params.description: The published request carries a JSON entity. Once application/json is known, an absent body is invalid. Opaque compressed captures and unresolved MIME macros are left unverified.
